reviewer: Separate runtime author, read-only builder source review; no real build
review_scope: Builder logic and expected receipt schemas only; no stage,archive,VM or model execution

checks.worker_review_schema: complete/source_review_pass/worker/contract exact current pins required before staging
checks.packet_helper_review_schema: complete/source_review_pass/sources[]/contract/shell joins strip only auxiliary review metadata
checks.source_copy: Before/after source pin and copied target size/SHA checked; no weight loading
checks.staging_namespace: Fresh exclusive stage, static map and packet.verify direct FIXED metadata/model/prototype bindings
checks.license_retention: Retained CodeFormer license/notice copied from local project
checks.archive_logic: Explicit gzip wrapper plus streaming tar; exact per-member content SHA/size,unique membership/full expected coverage readback
checks.no_execution: Only inert packet verification and PIL asset byte inspection inside explicit main; no worker/runtime invocation

remaining: Root must obtain current worker/helper review receipts and execute the byte-verified builder; successful source review does not prove a transfer archive or VM preflight.
